task_instruction: Rewrite each sentence in the passive voice. Change the verb in the subordinate clause and keep the main clause unchanged.
paragraphs: At a remote observatory, engineer Lena and historian Omar test an experimental time gate. {{red:Professor Vale believes that a solar storm damaged the observatory's first clock in 2042.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:Lena discovers that the gate uses a sequence of magnetic pulses.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:Omar suspects that a visitor moved the brass control key during the night.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:The team confirms that a power surge has erased several entries from the arrival log.}} {{mask_4}}

The researchers check the gate's records before opening it again. {{red:Lena explains that technicians are calibrating the time sensors this morning.}} {{mask_5}} {{red:Professor Vale expects that the engineers will replace the damaged relay tomorrow.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:Omar remembers that an assistant had stored the paper maps in a locked cabinet.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:The team knows that the gate can transport a small metal object between two dates.}} {{mask_8}}

Their first test sends a sealed brass capsule to a nearby year. {{red:Lena reports that the machine delivered the capsule safely.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:Omar notices that the capsule has changed the temperature of the water inside it.}} {{mask_10}} {{red:Professor Vale says that the team is recording every change in a laboratory notebook.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:The assistants believe that the gate will return the capsule at midnight.}} {{mask_12}}

A brief warning light appears, so the team pauses the experiment. {{red:Lena insists that an operator must check the emergency switch before each test.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:Professor Vale admits that a loose cable caused the warning earlier.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:Omar observes that the backup system is protecting the control room now.}} {{mask_15}} {{red:The team learns that a technician has repaired the secondary power supply.}} {{mask_16}}

By evening, the observatory is ready for another carefully monitored test. {{red:Professor Vale announces that the engineers have completed the safety inspection.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:Lena believes that the control computer will store the next reading automatically.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:Omar hopes that the research team can publish its findings next year.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:Everyone agrees that the director should review the final checklist before the test begins.}} {{mask_20}} The time gate starts, and the brass capsule disappears from the table.
